_note: Numbers reported by the papers, NOT measured by us. First transcribed from the arXiv HTML versions on 2026-11-11; I0T, GR-CLIP, Liu and Sato entries re-checked against the PDFs on 2026-11-13 (I0T and Sato: ACL Anthology versions; GR-CLIP: arXiv v1; Liu: arXiv v1). Each entry gives the exact source.

mind_the_gap_table1.paper: Liang et al., Mind the Gap, NeurIPS 2022, arXiv:2203.02053
mind_the_gap_table1.source: Table 1 (Section 5.1). Values are the max over the shift grid on the test set (see official code shift_features.ipynb, plot_metrics).

i0t_table2.paper: An et al., I0T: Embedding Standardization Method Towards Zero Modality Gap, ACL 2025 (Long Papers), pp. 27182-27199, doi:10.18653/v1/2025.acl-long.1319, arXiv:2412.14384
i0t_table2.dataset: Flickr30k 1k, Karpathy VALIDATION split (Appendix D.2), first caption per image only
i0t_table2.statistics_source_note: Sec. 5.3 / Table 3 vary the number of 'test samples' used for the means; Sec. 5.3: 'I0T_post using the entire test sample, as we originally defined'; Limitations: 'relies on the entire test dataset'. The samples are from the evaluation split (Karpathy validation).
i0t_table2.model_note: I0T_post is applied to fine-tuned encoders, not to the original CLIP: Sec. 2/5.1 'on the frozen encoders from the first stage'; 'our final I0T_post is designed based on LCCOM' (Long-CyCLIP-only + MCSIE, fine-tuned on COCO). The 'CLIP' row appears to be the original pretrained model (our inference: its 5-caption I2T in Table 5, 78.5, is close to open_clip's 78.9 for ViT-B/32 on the Flickr30k test split). The Table 2 difference therefore combines fine-tuning and centering.

i0t_table9.paper: An et al., I0T: Embedding Standardization Method Towards Zero Modality Gap, ACL 2025 (Long Papers), pp. 27182-27199, doi:10.18653/v1/2025.acl-long.1319, arXiv:2412.14384
i0t_table9.source: Appendix, Table 9 and the text before it ('ResNet-based CLIP')
i0t_table9.dataset: same retrieval protocol as Table 2 (Flickr30k 1k, Karpathy validation, first caption)
i0t_table9.model: CLIP RN50 (original pretrained weights, no fine-tuning)
i0t_table9.text: 'Whereas the T2I score is 3.1 higher than that of CLIP, the I2T score is 3.3 lower than the CLIP I2T score.'

grclip.paper: Li et al., Closing the Modality Gap for Mixed Modality Search (method: GR-CLIP), NeurIPS 2025, arXiv:2507.19054 (v1 checked; marked 'Preprint. Under review.')
grclip.scoring: cosine similarity after mean subtraction (Algorithm 1, line 21: s = e_q . e_d / (||e_q|| ||e_d||)); for ranking this equals re-normalizing, i.e. our M1, not M2
grclip.means: from ~10k samples of the TRAINING splits of several datasets (MSCOCO, Google WIT, NFCorpus, VisualNews, OVEN), 'to ensure generalization across datasets and prevent test-set leakage'; separate means for queries, text documents and images (and an OVEN-specific query mean)

liu2026_table4.paper: Liu et al. 2026, The Geometry of Compromise: Unlocking Generative Capabilities via Controllable Modality Alignment, arXiv:2604.00279v1 (31 Mar 2026; preprint, not peer reviewed)
liu2026_table4.model_note: Not named in the retrieval table. Implementation details: 'We fine-tune the pre-trained ViT-B/32 ... on CC3M'; 'All fine-tuning and post-processing baselines use the same training data, number of epochs, and backbone'. The 'Original CLIP' row is labelled 'Pretrained' in Table 1. Whether Mean-Centering is applied to the pretrained or a fine-tuned model, and which data the centroids come from, is not stated (not found).
liu2026_table4.distribution_gap_definition: Sec. 3: 'the residual gap after centroid alignment, measured as the average cosine distance between centered embeddings' -> computed on centered vectors by definition.

sato2026_appD3.paper: Sato, Kiyama, Hirasawa, Komachi. When Modality Gap Reduction Fails: Prediction-Level Hubness in CLIP. EMNLP 2026 (main), pp. 23060-23083, Anthology ID 2026.emnlp-main.1002, arXiv:2609.01103
sato2026_appD3.finding: Appendix D.3: centering's effect on the accuracy of the uncorrected model is 'dataset-dependent, from -4.2 points (Flowers102) to +4.1 points (EuroSAT) under the dataset-specific templates, and up to +15.3 points on EuroSAT under the generic template'.
sato2026_appD3.per_dataset_note: Only the extremes are given in the text.
sato2026_appD3.alpha_definition: alpha is the strength of a linear (Mind-the-Gap-style) shift: x - alpha*g, t + alpha*g (Sec. 4); not a centering scale.
sato2026_appD3.limitations: 'we do not claim that they carry over to cross-modal retrieval'; retrieval metrics 'would have to be reformulated—plausibly in terms of top-k occupancy across queries—which we have not done.'

openclip_retrieval_results.source: open_clip repository, docs/openclip_retrieval_results.csv (main branch, read 2026-11-13; commit not pinned): https://github.com/mlfoundations/open_clip/blob/main/docs/openclip_retrieval_results.csv
openclip_retrieval_results.produced_with: clip_benchmark (LAION), Flickr30k 1k and MSCOCO 5k test, 5 captions per image
